O Greatly Merciful God, Infinite Goodnes: Ruhanga ow'embabazi nyingi, oburungi obutarikuhwaho, eriizooba abantu boona nibashaba kuruga omu kabi kaabo kuhika aha mbabazi zaawe, n'okusaasira kwaawe, Ruhanga; kandi nibashaba n'eiraka ryabo ery'amaani ery'obusaasi. Ruhanga w'embabazi, otakanga okushaba kw'abantu abaabingirwe omu nsi! O Mukama, Oburungi obutarikwetegyerezibwa, orikumanya obusaasi bwaitu kurungi, kandi orikumanya ngu omu maani gaitu titurikubaasa kugyenda ahariiwe, nitukushaba: otuhe embabazi zaawe kandi ogumizemu okwongyera embabazi zaawe omuriitwe, kugira ngu tukore ebyo ebirikwera byawe omu bwesigwa omu magara gaitu goona hamwe n'omu shaaha y'okufa. Reka amaani ga embabazi zaawe gatuboneze kuruga omu mizingo y'abazigu b'okucungurwa kwaitu, kugira ngu tubaase kutegyereza okwiija kwa [Omwana waawe] okwahamuheru, ekiro ekirikumanywa naiwe wenka. Kandi nituteekateeka kutunga buri kimwe eki Yesu yaaraganiise n'obu twakuba turi ababi munonga. O Yesu, ku ndikureeba omuhendo gw'eshagama yaawe, nshemererwa ahabw'obuhango bwayo, ahabw'okuba akatondo kamwe kokaba nikamara okucungura abasiisi boona. N'obu ekibi kiraabe kiri ekiina ky'obubi hamwe n'obutasiima, omuhendo ogurashashurwa ahabwaitu tigurikubaasa kugyeragyeranisibwa. Iguru hamwe n'ensi nibibaasa kuhinduka, kwonka okusaasira kwa Ruhanga tikurikwija kuhwaho. Oh, n'okushemererwa kw'amaani okurikwotsya omu mutima gwangye ku ndikureeba oburungi bwawe obutarikwetegyerezibwa, O Yesu! Ninyenda kureeta abasiisi boona aha bigyere byawe kugira ngu bahimbise okusaasira kwawe omu myaka etarikuhwaho (Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska, 72).
